sql: select 'live_orders_Emmsell10' as what, coalesce(strategy,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where strategy like 'Emmsell10%' group by strategy union all select 'live_nonterminal_any', coalesce(strategy,'-'), count(*)::text from live_orders where status in ('resting','open','pending','partially_filled') group by strategy union all select 'deployments_open', d.deployment_key, coalesce(a.strategy_tag,'-') from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id=d.id where e.key='mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap' and d.ended_at is null union all select 'gmmsell_60m', strategy, count(*)::text from paper_trades where strategy like 'Gmmsell%' and created_at > now() - interval '60 minutes' group by strategy
